content.short: Looping Collective offers tokenized looped DeFi strategies on HYPE, stablecoins and BTC.
content.description: Looping Collective packages leveraged looping strategies into liquid tokens on Hyperliquid, so users gain the amplified yield of repeated deposit-and-borrow cycles without managing the loop or its liquidation risk directly. Looping magnifies both the return and the sensitivity to rate changes, which is the part that tokenizing does not remove.
